title: weather.current
description: Get current weather conditions for the configured location (AETHER_WEATHER_LAT/LON/LABEL env vars). Returns temperature in both °F and °C, humidity %, wind speed in mph, plain-English conditions string (e.g. 'Partly cloudy', 'Light rain'), the underlying WMO weather code, feels-like temperature, and a fetch timestamp. Polled from Open-Meteo every 15 minutes; this surface returns the most recently cached reading. When env vars are unset, returns { available: false, reason: 'no_config' } rather than throwing — node operates in graceful-degradation mode consistent with auxiliary-writes-isolation (CLAUDE.md §11.8).
